# Collabor8

> The app helping separated and divorced co-parents in the UK manage child maintenance payments and shared expenses with clarity and transparency.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home - Learn how Collabor8 helps co-parents manage payments, track shared expenses, and stay on top of child maintenance.
- [/about](/about): About Collabor8 - our story and mission.
- [/podcast](/podcast): The Collabor8 Blog - practical guides, videos and resources for separated parents navigating family finances.
- [/splash](/splash): App entry point for returning users.
- [/signup](/signup): Create a Collabor8 account - choose whether you're the parent managing payments or the parent viewing them.
- [/login](/login): Sign in to your Collabor8 account.
- [/forgot-password](/forgot-password): Reset your account password.
- [/dashboard](/dashboard): Main app dashboard - view and manage payment schedules, shared expenses, and upcoming payments.
- [/profile](/profile): Manage your profile, linked co-parent, and account settings.
- [/settings](/settings): App settings and preferences.
- [/edit-payment](/edit-payment): Set up or edit recurring child maintenance payments.
- [/payment-history](/payment-history): Full transaction history and payment records.
- [/child-maintenance-calculator](/child-maintenance-calculator): Free UK government-style child maintenance calculator - estimate your baseline payment amount.
- [/resources/child-maintenance-guide](/resources/child-maintenance-guide): Comprehensive guide to child maintenance in the UK - what it is, who pays, how to set up payments, shared expenses, and rights.
- [/resources/support-and-guidance](/resources/support-and-guidance): Support resources, FAQs, and guidance for co-parents.
- [/resources/financial-coparenting-tips](/resources/financial-coparenting-tips): Practical tips for managing finances as co-parents.
- [/privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [/cookies](/cookies): Cookie policy.

## Guides and tools
- [Child maintenance calculator](https://collaborate8.com/child-maintenance-calculator): Free child maintenance calculator based on the official UK CMS formula. Calculate weekly, monthly and annual payments instantly.
- [Child maintenance made simple](https://collaborate8.com/resources/child-maintenance-guide): Everything separated parents need to know about child maintenance in the UK. What it is, who pays, how to calculate it, and how to manage it with Collabor8.
- [Financial Co-parenting Tips](https://collaborate8.com/resources/financial-coparenting-tips): Practical financial co-parenting tips for separated parents in the UK.
- [What does child maintenance cover?](https://collaborate8.com/resources/what-does-child-maintenance-cover): What child maintenance is for, and simple ways UK parents can split extra costs fairly.
- [How to write a child maintenance agreement](https://collaborate8.com/resources/child-maintenance-agreement): What to include, how to review it, and why a written family arrangement isn't legally binding.
- [How long do you pay child maintenance for?](https://collaborate8.com/resources/how-long-do-you-pay-child-maintenance): Child maintenance usually runs until your child is 16, or under 20 if they stay in approved education or training.
- [Finances after separation: where to start](https://collaborate8.com/resources/finances-after-separation): A calm checklist for sorting money: child maintenance, shared costs, records, benefits checks and where to get free help.
- [Is my child maintenance fair?](https://collaborate8.com/resources/is-my-child-maintenance-fair): How UK child maintenance is worked out: gross income, number of children, overnight stays and other children.
- [How does conflict between parents affect children?](https://collaborate8.com/resources/parental-conflict-and-children): Research for the government links frequent, unresolved conflict between parents to children's wellbeing. What helps.
- [How to talk to your ex about child maintenance without a row](https://collaborate8.com/resources/talking-to-your-ex-about-money): Calm, practical steps for talking to your ex about child maintenance and shared costs: prepare, start with facts, write it down, review.
